description: This file defines the RescheduledAuditActionService class, which handles audit actions related to rescheduling bookings, including versioning, data parsing, display formatting, and log matching.

classes.name: RescheduledAuditActionService
classes.description: Class implementing IAuditActionService to handle rescheduled booking audit actions with versioning and display methods.

methods.name: getVersionedData
methods.description: Returns versioned data for the given fields.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number from data.

methods.name: migrateToLatest
methods.description: Validates and migrates data to the latest schema version.

methods.name: getDataRequirements
methods.description: Returns data requirements for the audit action.

methods.name: getDisplayTitle
methods.description: Generates display title with date formatting and link components.

methods.name: getDisplayTitleForRescheduledFromLog
methods.description: Generates display title for reschedule logs.

methods.name: getDisplayJson
methods.description: Returns JSON data for display, including formatted times.

methods.name: getMatchingLog
methods.description: Finds the log that created a specific booking based on UID.
